say:0:1221501001:0.text: Eh? There's something shiny over there!
say:0:1221501001:0.source_cn: 咦，那里有什么东西在反光！

say:1:1221501002:0.text: Seems to be a glass bottle...

say:0:1221502001:0.text: How odd. The handwriting on the note is wobbly and crooked...
say:0:1221502001:0.source_cn: 奇怪的漂流瓶，里面的纸条写得断断续续、歪歪扭扭的……
say:0:1221502001:0.male: How odd. The handwriting on the note is wobbly and crooked...
say:0:1221502001:0.female: How odd. The handwriting on the note is wobbly and crooked...

say:1:1221502002:0.text: The bottle isn't sealed, and the note is dry—looks like it hasn't touched the water yet.
say:1:1221502002:0.source_cn: 瓶口没有密封，纸条也没被打湿——这瓶子看起来还没见过水。
say:1:1221502002:0.male: The bottle isn't sealed, and the note is dry—looks like it hasn't touched the water yet.
say:1:1221502002:0.female: The bottle isn't sealed, and the note is dry—looks like it hasn't touched the water yet.

say:2:1221502003:0.text: Whoever wrote this note might still be nearby!
say:2:1221502003:0.source_cn: 咦，说不定写纸条的人就在附近呢！
say:2:1221502003:0.male: Whoever wrote this note might still be nearby!
say:2:1221502003:0.female: Whoever wrote this note might still be nearby!

say:0:1221504001:0.text: He's finally calmed down... Wait, why is he staring at the bottle in my hand? So creepy!
say:0:1221504001:0.source_cn: 总算冷静了……哇，他怎么盯着我手里的漂流瓶，好可怕！

say:3:1221505001:0.text: Why do you keep staring at the bottle we found?
say:3:1221505001:0.source_cn: 你一直盯我们找到的漂流瓶，是为什么……？

say:6:1221505003:0.text: Mine... I, sailor... Come back... Bang, bang, bang! Ah... Ahhh!
say:6:1221505003:0.source_cn: 我的……我，水手……返航……砰，砰砰！啊……啊——

say:7:1221505004:0.text: You're a sailor? Bang, bang, bang on your way back? Um, what does that mean?
say:7:1221505004:0.source_cn: 你是个水手？在返航途中……砰砰砰……呃，什么是“砰砰砰”啊！
say:7:1221505004:0.male: You're a sailor? Bang, bang, bang on your way back? Um, what does that mean?
say:7:1221505004:0.female: You're a sailor? Bang, bang, bang on your way back? Um, what does that mean?

choice_prompt:8:1221505004.text: You're a sailor? Bang, bang, bang on your way back? Um, what does that mean?
choice_prompt:8:1221505004.source_cn: 你是个水手？在返航途中……砰砰砰……呃，什么是“砰砰砰”啊！
choice_prompt:8:1221505004.male: You're a sailor? Bang, bang, bang on your way back? Um, what does that mean?
choice_prompt:8:1221505004.female: You're a sailor? Bang, bang, bang on your way back? Um, what does that mean?

say:9:1221505005:0.text: Gunfire? You must have gone through an intense battle!
say:9:1221505005:0.source_cn: 枪炮声？那你一定遇到了一场激烈的战斗！

say:10:1221505007:0.text: Didn't we have a naval battle with the Dead Tide Fleet before? I think I know what happened!
say:10:1221505007:0.source_cn: 对了，死潮舰队之前不是和我们打过海战吗？满满知道了！

say:11:1221505008:0.text: He must have been a Dead Tide Fleet soldier who got knocked into the sea after an explosion. He then passed out and eventually drifted here.
say:11:1221505008:0.source_cn: 他是死潮舰队的士兵，海战时被炮弹的冲击力拍进海中，失去...
say:11:1221505008:0.male: He must have been a Dead Tide Fleet soldier who got knocked into the sea after an explosion. He then passed out and eventually drifted here.
say:11:1221505008:0.female: He must have been a Dead Tide Fleet soldier who got knocked into the sea after an explosion. He then passed out and eventually drifted here.

choice_prompt:12:1221505008.text: He must have been a Dead Tide Fleet soldier who got knocked into the sea after an explosion. He then passed out and eventually drifted here.
choice_prompt:12:1221505008.source_cn: 他是死潮舰队的士兵，海战时被炮弹的冲击力拍进海中，失去意识，最后漂到了这个地方！
choice_prompt:12:1221505008.male: He must have been a Dead Tide Fleet soldier who got knocked into the sea after an explosion. He then passed out and eventually drifted here.
choice_prompt:12:1221505008.female: He must have been a Dead Tide Fleet soldier who got knocked into the sea after an explosion. He then passed out and eventually drifted here.

say:13:1221505009:0.text: Did you just agree with me, Magister? Looks like Chippy's getting smarter and smarter!
say:13:1221505009:0.source_cn: 主人也认可满满的推理吗？果然，满满越来越聪明了！
say:13:1221505009:0.male: Did you just agree with me, Magister? Looks like Chippy's getting smarter and smarter!
say:13:1221505009:0.female: Did you just agree with me, Magister? Looks like Chippy's getting smarter and smarter!

say:15:1221505013:0.text: Go home... Deena, Deena... Lisa, my dear...
say:15:1221505013:0.source_cn: 回家……小蒂娜，小蒂娜……丽莎，亲爱的……

say:16:1221505014:0.text: Experiment? That's what the note inside the bottle mentions. Maybe... he's one of Viperian's test subjects and was forced to turn into a Graveborn?
say:16:1221505014:0.source_cn: 实验？漂流瓶的纸条里也这么写，或许……他是维珀里安的实...

say:17:1221505015:0.text: That explains everything—the sailor's ship capsized during the battle while he was on his way home, and he was later captured by Viperian to undergo the transformation.
say:17:1221505015:0.source_cn: 这就全说通了。一个返航回家的水手，他的船遇上海战失事，...

say:18:1221505016:0.text: After being transformed into a Graveborn, he still had some self-awareness. His determination to come home motivated him to escape...
say:18:1221505016:0.source_cn: 他变成了亡灵，但依旧保存了一些自我意识，想要回家，所以...

say:19:1221505017:0.text: I guess Deena and Lisa are his daughter and wife... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what he went through is truly heartbreaking. Let's help him!
say:19:1221505017:0.source_cn: 小蒂娜和丽莎，大概是他的女儿和妻子吧……<style=...
say:19:1221505017:0.male: I guess Deena and Lisa are his daughter and wife... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what he went through is truly heartbreaking. Let's help him!
say:19:1221505017:0.female: I guess Deena and Lisa are his daughter and wife... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what he went through is truly heartbreaking. Let's help him!

say:20:1221505018:0.text: Go home... Deena... Lisa... Ah! Ah!!! Ahhh!!!
say:20:1221505018:0.source_cn: 回家……小蒂娜……丽莎……啊、啊啊……啊——

say:21:1221505019:0.source_cn: 他的精神状态又不太稳定了……

say:24:1221505010:0.text: Indeed, he's quite different from the other Dead Tide Fleet soldiers we've encountered.
say:24:1221505010:0.source_cn: 的确，他和我们见过的死潮舰队士兵很不一样。

say:25:1221505011:0.text: Alright, but we just don't have enough clues to be certain of anything now...
say:25:1221505011:0.source_cn: 好吧，可目前只有这些线索嘛……

choice:8:0:1.text: It should be the sound of gunfire...
choice:8:0:1.male: It should be the sound of gunfire...
choice:8:0:1.female: It should be the sound of gunfire...

say:26:1221505006:0.text: If cannonballs or bombs were involved, it must have been something huge...
say:26:1221505006:0.source_cn: 如果是炮弹或者炸弹爆炸，那肯定是什么大事件……

say:0:1221506001:0.text: He seems a bit deranged. Let's follow him!
say:0:1221506001:0.source_cn: 他的神智有些混乱，我们快跟上去！

say:3:1221507001:0.text: Experiment... No! No! ...D—Don't come near me... Ah!!!

say:4:1221507002:0.text: There, there. We aren't bad guys! We won't run any experiments on you.
say:4:1221507002:0.source_cn: 别害怕，我们不是坏人，不会用你做实验的。

say:5:1221507003:0.text: Exactly! We're here to help you! Our magister is a powerful mage!
say:5:1221507003:0.source_cn: 对呀对呀！我们是来帮助你的，我们的主人是大魔法师，可厉害了！
say:5:1221507003:0.male: Exactly! We're here to help you! Our magister is a powerful mage!
say:5:1221507003:0.female: Exactly! We're here to help you! Our magister is a powerful mage!

say:9:1221507007:0.text: Rustport... Go home... Help me... Home...

say:11:1221507008:0.text: Also... he can never turn back into a human now...
say:11:1221507008:0.source_cn: 而且……他已经是亡灵，没办法再变回人类了……

say:12:1221507009:0.text: Things in Rustport are critical at the moment. Even if we manage to bring him back, his presence's bound to cause a lot of upheaval.
say:12:1221507009:0.source_cn: 在现在这种紧张的局面下，就算我们能带他回锈锚港，也一定...

say:13:1221507010:0.text: What else can we do if we can't bring him back home...
say:13:1221507010:0.source_cn: 该怎么办呢？如果不能带他回家的话……

say:14:1221507011:0.text: Go home, no... Potion... Pain, unbearable... No!!!
say:14:1221507011:0.source_cn: 回家，不能……药水……痛，好难受……不，不！

say:15:1221507012:0.text: Dead, all dead... Green... snake... Snake! Ahhh!
say:15:1221507012:0.source_cn: 死了，都死了……绿色的……蛇……有蛇！啊——

say:16:1221507013:0.text: Oh, no! He's losing his mind again! Watch out!
say:16:1221507013:0.source_cn: 糟了！他又失去理智了，小心！

choice:10:0:1.text: The sight of a Graveborn will cause an upheaval.
choice:10:0:1.male: The sight of a Graveborn will cause an upheaval.
choice:10:0:1.female: The sight of a Graveborn will cause an upheaval.

say:4:1221509002:0.text: He reacts that way no matter what we say...
say:4:1221509002:0.source_cn: 现在说什么他都是这个反应……

say:5:1221509003:0.text: Even the bottle can't make him lucid now. Magister, what should we do?
say:5:1221509003:0.source_cn: 漂流瓶也没办法让他保持清醒了。主人，该怎么办啊！
say:5:1221509003:0.male: Even the bottle can't make him lucid now. Magister, what should we do?
say:5:1221509003:0.female: Even the bottle can't make him lucid now. Magister, what should we do?

choice_prompt:6:1221509003.text: Even the bottle can't make him lucid now. Magister, what should we do?
choice_prompt:6:1221509003.source_cn: 漂流瓶也没办法让他保持清醒了。主人，该怎么办啊！
choice_prompt:6:1221509003.male: Even the bottle can't make him lucid now. Magister, what should we do?
choice_prompt:6:1221509003.female: Even the bottle can't make him lucid now. Magister, what should we do?

say:7:1221509004:0.text: Right! There might be other things that could bring him to his senses.
say:7:1221509004:0.source_cn: 对哦！除了漂流瓶，说不定还有别的东西能让他的神智变得清醒。

say:8:1221509007:0.text: Seems like he's been wandering around here since he escaped. If there's something else he cares about, it should be on this beach.
say:8:1221509007:0.source_cn: 他逃出来以后似乎一直在这里徘徊，如果还有什么东西，也应...

say:9:1221509008:0.source_cn: 这样的话，我们在附近找找看吧！

choice:6:0:1.text: Is there anything else he cares about?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 他有没有其它在意的东西？
choice:6:0:1.male: Is there anything else he cares about?
choice:6:0:1.female: Is there anything else he cares about?

say:11:1221509005:0.text: He really misses his wife and daughter...
say:11:1221509005:0.source_cn: 他很思念他的妻子和女儿呢……

say:12:1221509006:0.text: Objects related to his family might help.
say:12:1221509006:0.source_cn: 要是有和他的家人相关的物品，或许能让他清醒一点。

choice:6:1:2.text: Going home is his ultimate wish.
choice:6:1:2.male: Going home is his ultimate wish.
choice:6:1:2.female: Going home is his ultimate wish.

say:1:1221510002:0.text: Let's see if there's anything we can use inside.
say:1:1221510002:0.source_cn: 我们找找看有没有用得上的东西吧。

say:2:1221511001:1.text: There's a slightly rusty music box here. Is that an engraving...
say:2:1221511001:1.source_cn: 咦，一个八音盒……有点生锈了。上面是不是刻了什么字……

say:3:1221511002:1.text: "May you stay happy forever, my lovely Deena."
say:3:1221511002:1.source_cn: “愿我最可爱的小蒂娜永远快乐”。
say:3:1221511002:1.male: "May you stay happy forever, my lovely Deena."
say:3:1221511002:1.female: "May you stay happy forever, my lovely Deena."

say:4:1221511003:1.text: It belongs to him! Hopefully, this music box can help him clear his head.
say:4:1221511003:1.source_cn: 真的是那个人的东西！希望这个八音盒能让他找回一些理智。

say:3:1221512001:0.text: Go away... Go... Ah! Bone... Snake!

say:4:1221512002:0.text: Relax! I think this belongs to you!
say:4:1221512002:0.source_cn: 别害怕呀。你听，这应该是你的东西！

choice_prompt:6:1221512002.text: Relax! I think this belongs to you!
choice_prompt:6:1221512002.source_cn: 别害怕呀。你听，这应该是你的东西！

say:8:1221512003:0.source_cn: 音乐……小蒂娜……生日……送、送她……

say:9:1221512004:0.text: Great, it works! He seems much calmer now.
say:9:1221512004:0.source_cn: 太好了，真的有效果！他好像冷静下来了。

say:10:1221512005:0.text: ...Sorry, we really can't get you home. Do you have any other wishes?
say:10:1221512005:0.source_cn: 但是……对不起，我们真的没办法送你回家。嗯……你还有别...

say:14:1221512009:0.text: You want to write it yourself? The letter must mean a lot to you...
say:14:1221512009:0.source_cn: 想要自己写吗？这封信一定对你很重要吧……

narration:15:1221512010:0.text: The Graveborn sailor painstakingly scribbles a message in crooked, smeared handwriting.
narration:15:1221512010:0.source_cn: 亡灵水手用了许多时间，在信纸上歪歪扭扭地涂抹了一段话

say:16:1221512011:0.text: No. 7, Dockside Lane... Rustport... Lisa and Deena... G—Give them...
say:16:1221512011:0.source_cn: 锈锚港……码头区7号……丽莎·帕尔，蒂娜·帕尔……给，...

say:17:1221512012:0.text: Don't worry, I'll see to it that your letter reaches them. This is Sir Chippy's promise to you!
say:17:1221512012:0.source_cn: 放心吧，这封信一定会送到她们手里的。这是骑士满满的承诺！

say:19:1221512014:0.text: ...Painful... Headache... Help me... Free me... from suffering...
say:19:1221512014:0.source_cn: ……痛……头好痛，控制不了……帮我，帮我……解脱……

say:21:1221512016:0.text: ...Help me... Please... Send me to... the god... of the waves...
say:21:1221512016:0.source_cn: ……帮我……求你……送我去，风浪……与漂泊之神的……海波……

say:23:1221512018:0.text: He... He's completely lost his mind!

choice:12:0:1.text: Do you need help writing the letter?
choice:12:0:1.male: Do you need help writing the letter?
choice:12:0:1.female: Do you need help writing the letter?

choice:12:1:2.text: Do you want to finish writing the letter in the bottle?
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 想把漂流瓶里的信写完？
choice:12:1:2.male: Do you want to finish writing the letter in the bottle?
choice:12:1:2.female: Do you want to finish writing the letter in the bottle?

say:2:1221513101:1.text: He wants to meet the god of the waves...
say:2:1221513101:1.source_cn: 他想要我们送他去风浪与漂泊之神的海波中……

say:3:1221513102:1.text: Magister, let's bring him to the shore.
say:3:1221513102:1.source_cn: 梅林，咱们带他去海边吧。
say:3:1221513102:1.male: Magister, let's bring him to the shore.
say:3:1221513102:1.female: Magister, let's bring him to the shore.

say:4:1221513103:1.text: We'll hold a burial at sea for him!

narration:5:1221513104:0.text: We move the Graveborn sailor's body to the shore, hoping his soul will find its way to the god of the waves.
narration:5:1221513104:0.source_cn: 我们将亡灵水手的遗体带去了海边，该将他送往风浪与漂泊之...

say:0:1221514001:0.text: In his final moments, he called out to the god of the waves...
say:0:1221514001:0.source_cn: 他最后，念着风浪与漂泊之神的名字……

say:1:1221514002:0.text: Let's release him here. The waves will carry him to the god.
say:1:1221514002:0.source_cn: 就在这里将他送入大海吧，海浪会带他去神的身边。
say:1:1221514002:0.male: Let's release him here. The waves will carry him to the god.
say:1:1221514002:0.female: Let's release him here. The waves will carry him to the god.

narration:1:1221515001:0.text: As the waves wash over the shore, the Graveborn sailor's body sinks into the sea and fades out of sight along with the foam...
narration:1:1221515001:0.source_cn: 海浪拍打出白色的泡沫，亡灵水手的遗体沉入海中，随那些泡...

say:0:1221516001:0.text: Well, it's time to go back to Rustport.
say:0:1221516001:0.source_cn: 走吧，该回一趟锈锚港了。
say:0:1221516001:0.male: Well, it's time to go back to Rustport.
say:0:1221516001:0.female: Well, it's time to go back to Rustport.

say:1:1221516002:0.text: We shall pass the music box and the glass bottle over to his family.
say:1:1221516002:0.source_cn: 嗯，回去把八音盒和漂流瓶带给他的家人。

say:0:1221517001:0.text: No. 7, Dockside Lane... This should be the place.
say:0:1221517001:0.source_cn: 码头区7号……那个亡灵水手的家应该就是这里。

say:3:1221519001:0.text: We're here for Lisa and Deena.
say:3:1221519001:0.source_cn: 女士，我们想找丽莎·帕尔和蒂娜·帕尔。

say:5:1221519003:0.text: I don't think we've met. You guys are...

say:6:1221519004:0.text: Your father entrusted us to deliver something to you and your mother.
say:6:1221519004:0.source_cn: 我们是受你父亲的托付，来把这些东西送给你和你的母亲。

say:7:1221519005:0.text: Who? My father? Have you... seen him?! Where? How's that possible...
say:7:1221519005:0.source_cn: 谁？我父亲？你们……你们见过他？！在哪里见到的？怎么可能……
say:7:1221519005:0.male: Who? My father? Have you... seen him?! Where? How's that possible...
say:7:1221519005:0.female: Who? My father? Have you... seen him?! Where? How's that possible...

choice_prompt:8:1221519005.text: Who? My father? Have you... seen him?! Where? How's that possible...
choice_prompt:8:1221519005.source_cn: 谁？我父亲？你们……你们见过他？！在哪里见到的？怎么可能……
choice_prompt:8:1221519005.male: Who? My father? Have you... seen him?! Where? How's that possible...
choice_prompt:8:1221519005.female: Who? My father? Have you... seen him?! Where? How's that possible...

say:9:1221519006:0.text: Father... We tried so hard to talk him out of going to sea, but he insisted on leaving... He said it was the only way to make ends meet, and he promised to send money home if he made any...
say:9:1221519006:0.source_cn: 父亲……他出海前，我们劝了他很久，但他执意要走……说不...

say:10:1221519007:0.text: But he never came back... Mother was so heartbroken that she fell ill and passed away, leaving me all alone...
say:10:1221519007:0.source_cn: 可他再也没回来……后来，妈妈也因为痛苦和思念而生病去世...
say:10:1221519007:0.male: But he never came back... Mother was so heartbroken that she fell ill and passed away, leaving me all alone...
say:10:1221519007:0.female: But he never came back... Mother was so heartbroken that she fell ill and passed away, leaving me all alone...

choice_prompt:11:1221519007.text: But he never came back... Mother was so heartbroken that she fell ill and passed away, leaving me all alone...
choice_prompt:11:1221519007.source_cn: 可他再也没回来……后来，妈妈也因为痛苦和思念而生病去世。只剩下我一个……
choice_prompt:11:1221519007.male: But he never came back... Mother was so heartbroken that she fell ill and passed away, leaving me all alone...
choice_prompt:11:1221519007.female: But he never came back... Mother was so heartbroken that she fell ill and passed away, leaving me all alone...

say:12:1221519008:0.text: I'm fine. The toughest times are already behind me.
say:12:1221519008:0.source_cn: 不，不用安慰我，最痛苦的时候已经过去了。

say:13:1221519009:0.text: My father was probably an exceptional sailor, but... he wasn't a good father...
say:13:1221519009:0.source_cn: 我爸爸或许是个出色的水手，但他……他不是个好父亲……

say:14:1221519010:0.text: Actually, he really missed you. Even though he'd turned into a Graveborn, his determination to come home never wavered.
say:14:1221519010:0.source_cn: 其实，他很想念你们。他变成了亡灵，可还是一心想要回家见你们。

say:15:1221519011:0.text: ...So what? Did he have any idea how badly we were bullied while he was away?
